data.one_liner: Web implementation of Firebase Analytics for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides the web platform implementation for the firebase_analytics plugin. It forwards analytics events from Flutter to Google Analytics on the web.
use_when: You need Google Analytics for Firebase in a Flutter web app
You already use firebase_core and want analytics support on web
avoid_when: You need a custom analytics solution
strengths: Simple to add as a dependency
weaknesses: No additional features beyond the core analytics API

alternatives.name: firebase_analytics
alternatives.why_pick_it: Main package that includes all platform implementations, use if you need a single dependency
